newsitem.title: GREECE: Mailis sees 98 pct H1 earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Mailis sees 98 pct H1 earnings growth.

text.p: Athens bourse main market listing Mailis, a maker of steel tape used in packaging, expects first half consolidated sales will exceed 7.0 billion drachmas, an advance of 36 percent, it said on Thursday.

Consolidated pretax earnings are expected to jump 98 percent to 1.0 billion drachmas, helped by the performance of subsidiary companies which had a profitable first half -- over 150 million drachmas -- for the first time, the company said.
Mailis, a maker of steel and synthetic strap used in packaging, will seek shareholder approval for a two-for 10 scrip issue at its annual shareholders meeting scheduled for Friday June 27.
It plans to capitalise reserves of 3.28 billion drachmas.
Parent company first half sales grew 36.8 percent to 6.8 billion drachmas with pretax profit rising 65 percent to 870 million. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
